arXiv:2509.11291v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Calorimeters operating in high-radiation environments are susceptible to damage, leading to increased noise that can significantly degrade energy resolution. A common way to mitigate noise is to apply a higher energy threshold on the calorimeter cells, typically set a few standard deviations above the noise level. However, this method risks discarding cells with genuine energy deposits, worsening the energy resolution and the energy deposit pattern. In this paper, we investigate graph neural network (GNN) based algorithms as an alternative to rigid energy thresholds. We combined laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) with LED-based vis-NIR reflectance and multivariate machine learning to predict total carbon (TC) concentration and gravimetric moisture content (MC) in variably processed soils under varying humidity. Using 116 samples from eight Finnish agricultural sites spanning six USDA texture classes, we defined five calibration scenarios from near-constant-humidity, ball-milled material to minimally processed samples with natural moisture. Achieving high strength and adequate ductility in as-cast ductile iron without heat treatment remains a major challenge. In this work, a machine learning-assisted alloy design strategy integrating orthogonal experiments and ensemble learning was developed to establish composition-property relationships for composition optimization. Based on the optimized design and advanced casting technologies, including fully automatic cored-wire feeding spheroidization process, and triple inoculation, a heat-treatment-free high-strength ductile iron was successfully developed. The optimized alloy achieved a tensile strength of 974 MPa, a yield strength of 613 MPa, and an elongation of 6.2% in the as-cast state. arXiv:2603.12629v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum many-body systems coupled to out-of-equilibrium reservoirs can behave as active matter and exhibit signs of flocking. We consider a spinful Luttinger liquid subject to measurement processes that shuffle spin-up particles to the left and spin-down particles to the right. Existing quantum genomics studies address these constraints using fixed-architecture circuits without noise-calibrated validation on standardized benchmarks, leaving the potential of adaptive circuit topology largely unexplored. arXiv:2609.16749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism combines vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting. While altermagnetic signatures have been identified in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), non-invasive reversible control remains challenging. Here we report a route to electric-field-switchable altermagnetism in a flexible d0-MOF, in which polar substituents couple the external field to ligand rotation.
